plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Lazy senior dev mode for ZCode, ported from DietrichGebert/ponytail 5.3.3 (MIT). The best code is the code you never wrote: YAGNI, reuse first, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions. Always-on ruleset injection with a codebase map, plus /ponytail-review, /ponytail-audit, /ponytail-debt, /ponytail-gain and /ponytail-help.

displayName_i18n.zh-CN: Ponytail 懒人高级开发模式

description_i18n.zh-CN: 防过度工程化的懒人高级开发模式：最少代码解决问题，先复用已有代码，防止重复造轮子。移植自 DietrichGebert/ponytail (MIT)。
